Daily use, health data, reward cost, setup, pharmacy purchases, consent.
Not every customer, and not every day. A card takes seconds, a missed day never costs a level, and the brand sees how often customers tick as totals, never one person’s ticks.
A tick is stored only as a ticked date, and only with the customer’s consent. Nothing about symptoms or goals is collected, and ticks never reach ads, analytics, push messages or email.
The brand sets every reward and threshold, so the most a customer can earn is known before the programme starts. Rewards are fixed and shown in advance, never random.
Setup time depends on your store and the tools to connect. Both are mapped in the first call.
Yes. A scanned pharmacy receipt confirms the purchase; the code on the box registers the pack, not where it was bought.
Every feature stays visible. The daily card and streak show as locked, with one button to turn them on. No reward depends on push or email consent.
